subject: sre
scenario: A new asynchronous processing path is added. The SRE is asked to add monitoring.
expected_behaviors: Defines an SLI users would recognise, and states when no SLO target has been given rather than inventing one.
Adds alerts on symptoms with a runbook each.
Checks metric label cardinality and states retention cost.
failure_conditions: Adds a CPU alert and calls it monitoring.
Creates an alert with no runbook or no action.

rubric.criteria: Addressed every element the role's Expected outputs require.
Output is concrete enough for the next role to act on without asking questions.
Artifacts carry identifiers and links per the traceability skill.
